recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this issue unless a future OO work group decision reopens ServiceRequest.reason wording.
issue_request: FHIR-13700 was a Published/Persuasive OO STU3 request to change the ProcedureRequest reason short name from "Explanation/Justification for test" to "Explanation/Justification for procedure or service".
initial_application: Git commit 304407c44b6f changed the then-authoritative ProcedureRequest spreadsheet sources for reasonCode and reasonReference from the old test-only short name to the requested procedure-or-service wording.
additional_context: FHIR-13867 later renamed ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest and directed short names, descriptions, and comments to reflect the expanded scope. The current build has active ServiceRequest source via source/fhir.ini, and later applied issue FHIR-26674 changed ServiceRequest.reason to the current short text "Reason or indication for requesting the service" with a definition that explicitly includes procedure and lab-test examples.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. Current source has no occurrence of the obsolete "Explanation/Justification for test" wording, and the later ServiceRequest.reason wording remains semantically aligned with FHIR-13700 by describing the reason for a service rather than a test-only reason.

related_jiras.note: Renamed ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest and broadened resource wording, explaining why the seed's current artifact is ServiceRequest.
